title: A document renders one of its blocks
body:
coax lays a reply out one top-level block at a time, because it draws code blocks, tables and tab groups as parts of their own. Its `render_block` builds a new one-block `Document` for each block, cloning the block and every link of the reply so that link indices stay the same.

## Proposal

Either of:

- `Document::render_block(&self, index: usize, format: Format) -> Page`
- `Page::blocks(&self) -> &[Range<usize>]`, the rows each top-level block covers, so coax renders once and splits the page.

## Open

- Which of the two. The second keeps one render per reply. The first keeps coax's current shape.
